note: 逐步收集中：第 1 步為 OSPAR 涵蓋的北海與東北大西洋（2026-09）；其他海域的離岸風場暫列「型式不詳」
Collected step by step: step 1 covers the North Sea and NE Atlantic within OSPAR (Sep 2026); offshore farms elsewhere are shown as “type unknown” for now

Thornton Bank I.zh: 第一期 6 部風機坐在混凝土重力式基礎上；OSPAR 把三期合成一筆「重力式／套管」
Thornton Bank I.en: The six phase-1 turbines stand on concrete gravity bases; OSPAR lists the three phases together as “gravity-based/jacket”

Thornton Bank II.zh: 第二、三期共 48 部風機用鋼製套管基礎（OWEC 設計）
Thornton Bank II.en: Phases 2 and 3 (48 turbines) use steel jackets designed by OWEC

Thornton Bank III.zh: 第二、三期共 48 部風機用鋼製套管基礎（OWEC 設計）
Thornton Bank III.en: Phases 2 and 3 (48 turbines) use steel jackets designed by OWEC

alpha ventus.zh: 6 部三腳架、6 部套管；OSPAR 誤列為「單樁／套管」
alpha ventus.en: 6 tripods and 6 jackets; OSPAR wrongly lists “monopile/jacket”

OSPAR says monopiles, but this test site had a suction-bucket trial turbine, and the capacities disagree (14 vs 7.6 MW)
Belwind Alstom Haliade demonstrator: OSPAR 把它併在 Belwind 一期（單樁）裡，這部示範機的基礎要另外查證
OSPAR merges it into Belwind phase 1 (monopiles); this demonstrator’s own foundation still has to be checked
